exercises.title: Write du -d
exercises.task: Write Du: from a list of files and their sizes, print every directory with its total size, like du -d N. The spec is in the comments of the file. Run prints the output for a small project at depths 0, 1 and 2.
hints: Build a tree first: a directory node holds the sizes of its own files and a map from name to child directory. Split each path on /; every part but the last is a directory.
The total of a directory is its files plus the totals of its children: a post-order recursion (1.3.3) that returns the total.
Print in post-order too, like du: the children (sorted by name) before the directory, and only directories whose depth is ≤ maxDepth. Compute the totals of deeper ones anyway.
